title: Game
description: Play casual eight-ball with two people sharing one device. Aim, set your power and take turns at the table.

title: Solar System
description: Explore NASA models and original asteroid models in an animated Solar System. Select a body, adjust time speed and compare two display scales. Circular orbits are illustrative, not an ephemeris.

title: Product Studio
description: Inspect original fictional packaging studies: a food tin and a beverage can. Explore illustrative component states and reset the product.
